test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When was the National Digital Communications Policy launched in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Digital Communications Policy** was launched in **2018** by the **Government of India**.
 
• This policy aimed at providing **broadband** for all, creating **4 million jobs** in the digital communications sector, and enhancing the contribution of the digital communications sector to **8% of India's GDP**.
 
• The policy envisions ensuring **universal broadband connectivity** at 50 Mbps to every citizen.
 
• It focuses on providing 1 Gbps connectivity to all **Gram Panchayats** by 2020 and 10 Gbps by 2022.
 
• One of its key missions is to propel India to the top 50 nations in the **ICT Development Index** of the International Telecommunication Union.
 
• It also aims to attract investments worth **USD 100 billion** in the digital communications sector.
 
• The policy promotes innovation and startup ecosystems in the digital communication sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Points Related to the Correct Answer**__

 
 
• The policy addresses the need for enhancing the coverage of **broadband** and increasing the speed of internet services across the country.
 
• It aims at developing a **robust digital infrastructure** to support the vision of a digital-first economy.
 
• The policy emphasizes the importance of **emerging technologies** like 5G, IoT (Internet of Things), and AI (Artificial Intelligence) in driving economic growth.
 
• It also focuses on ensuring digital **sovereignty** and security by promoting **indigenous manufacturing** and establishing a comprehensive data protection regime.
